Name: Elkanah, Son of Assir
Summary: Son of Assir and father of Ebiasaph in the Kohathite line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:23: Son of Assir and father of Ebiasaph in the Kohathite line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Elkanah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
